answer: At the dawn of each epoch, every agent must register a kin‑linked vault that ties its identity to a unique payment source, a shared timing pulse, and a cryptographic inlet that records the first transaction hash; the vault emits an ember‑signed proof that can only be generated once per source. When a new identity attempts registration, the protocol cross‑checks its inlet against existing vaults; any match merges the candidate into the existing entity, instantly invalidating the duplicate.
